question: Identify the top 10 and bottom 10 interest categories based on their highest composition values across all months. For each category, display the time(MM-YYYY), interest name, and the composition value
sql:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    im.interest_name,
    imet.month_year AS time,
    imet.composition,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY im.interest_name ORDER BY imet.composition DESC) AS rn
  FROM interest_metrics imet
  JOIN interest_map im ON imet.interest_id = im.id
),
top10 AS (
  SELECT interest_name, time, composition
  FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1
  ORDER BY composition DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
bottom10 AS (
  SELECT interest_name, time, composition
  FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1
  ORDER BY composition ASC
  LIMIT 10
)
SELECT interest_name, time, composition FROM top10
UNION ALL
SELECT interest_name, time, composition FROM bottom10
ORDER BY composition DESC
